preconditions.description: The number of testcases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(m, int) and 1 <= m <= 100000 for m in testcases_m)
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the number of columns m is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= val <= 10000 for val in row) for row in all_matrices)
preconditions.description: All coin values in the matrix are integers between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
The sum of m over all testcases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each testcase.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the game score.

postconditions.expression: all(score == min(max(bob_score_alice_path(k), bob_score_alice_path(k+1)) for k in range(m)) for score, matrix in zip(output_scores, all_matrices))
postconditions.description: For each testcase, the output score equals the minimum over all possible Alice paths of the maximum score Bob can achieve. Since Alice must switch rows exactly once at some column k (0-indexed), and Bob will choose the path maximizing his coins (either staying in row 0 until the end or staying in row 1 until the end, depending on Alice's path), the score is the minimum over k of the maximum of Bob's potential scores given Alice's specific path choice.
